--- title: "05 — Vent and non-vent signatures" subtitle: "Frenemies euk metaT — curated taxonomy, sample-unit level" author: "Hu Lab" date: last-modified format: html: toc: true toc-depth: 2 code-fold: show df-print: paged --- # Contents 1. **Who leads** the vent and non-vent signatures: each class-level taxon's share of expression and its occupancy, with the shares **summed to supergroup** (the 02 curated groups). 2. **What dominant taxa comprise vent and non-vent**: KEGG BRITE level-B composition of each habitat, and of each leading taxon. 3. **Habitat classes** for every KO and taxon (vent-only, vent-skewed, shared, non-vent-skewed, non-vent-only). The KO table is the hand-off to 06 and 07. 4. **Rarefied sensitivity**: the habitat classes recomputed at equal sequencing depth. All of it is descriptive (occupancy and relative share). **Unit expression.** Throughout this document, a unit's expression is the scaledTPM that remains after Eukaryota-only and Opisthokonta assignments are removed, averaged over the unit's replicates. Every proportion below is taken against that total. **Detection.** A feature is detected in a sample unit when its unit total is ≥ `detect_min_tpm` (1) scaledTPM **and** ≥ `detect_min_per_million` (10) per million of that unit's expression. scaledTPM carries library size (Soneson, Love & Robinson 2015, *F1000Research* 4:1521), and unit expression differs about 170-fold among units, so a TPM floor alone lets deep units detect more. The per-million floor protects deep units; the TPM floor protects shallow ones. **Occupancy.** Associated with a habitat = detected in ≥ 30% of its units (`occupancy_min_frac`: ≥ 4 of 13 vent units, ≥ 2 of 6 non-vent units). A fraction rather than a count, so the bar is the same height in both habitats. **Vent-only** is strict: vent-associated and detected in no non-vent unit. **Shares are relative.** A smaller share at vents means a smaller slice of protist expression, not fewer cells. # Set up ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} source(if (file.exists("_setup.R")) "_setup.R" else "scripts/_setup.R") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} FIELDS_IN_SCOPE <- c("Gorda Ridge", "Von Damm", "Piccard") CHOSEN_DEPTH <- 4 # grain locked in 02 MIN_TPM <- params$detect_min_tpm # 1 MIN_PER_MILLION <- params$detect_min_per_million # 10 OCC_MIN <- params$occupancy_min_frac # 0.30 N_LEADERS <- 10 # top taxa per habitat shown N_RAREFY <- 20 # rarefaction draws DELTA_REPORT <- 0.70 # descriptive |Cliff's delta| line, NOT calibrated ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # built once at the end of 02 (R/load_paired.R) paired <- load_paired(fields = FIELDS_IN_SCOPE, depth = CHOSEN_DEPTH) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` [load_paired] data/processed/paired_L4.RData (built 2026-10-23 09:06; 318,911 rows) ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} units <- paired |> distinct(unit = sample_unit, vent_bin, field, n_reps) |> arrange(vent_bin, field, unit) stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(units$unit)) units |> count(vent_bin, field) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: # 1. Sequencing depth and the detection rule Retained expression per unit, and KOs detected under the TPM floor alone versus the combined rule. The combined rule should track depth much less **within** a habitat. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ko_unit <- unit_expression(paired, "ko_id", min_tpm = MIN_TPM, min_per_million = MIN_PER_MILLION) depth_check <- ko_unit |> summarise(unit_total = first(unit_total), ko_tpm_floor = sum(tpm >= MIN_TPM), ko_detected = sum(detected), .by = c(unit, vent_bin, field)) |> arrange(unit_total) depth_check |> mutate(unit_total = round(unit_total)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ?cor() depth_check |> summarise(rho_tpm_floor = cor(unit_total, ko_tpm_floor, method = "spearman"), rho_combined = cor(unit_total, ko_detected, method = "spearman"), median_depth = median(unit_total), median_ko_detected = median(ko_detected), .by = vent_bin) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: Set a detection limit. # 2. Who leads each habitat Class-level (grain 4) taxa, summed to the 02 curated groups. `mean_share` is the mean across units of the taxon's share of each unit's expression, so every unit counts once regardless of depth. Median and maximum travel with it: a mean carried by one unit is a single-vent bloom, not a habitat-wide pattern. Define *dominance*: when ta ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} tax_unit <- unit_expression(paired, c("cur_group", "cur_L4"), min_tpm = MIN_TPM, min_per_million = MIN_PER_MILLION) tax_hab <- habitat_occupancy(tax_unit, units, c("cur_group", "cur_L4"), OCC_MIN) |> mutate(taxon = taxon_label_unique(cur_L4), .after = cur_L4) group_unit <- unit_expression(paired, "cur_group") group_totals <- complete_units(group_unit, units, "cur_group") |> summarise(mean_share = mean(share), median_share = median(share), min_share = min(share), max_share = max(share), .by = c(cur_group, vent_bin)) |> arrange(vent_bin, desc(mean_share)) # taxa needed to reach 50% / 80% of mean expression in each habitat dominance <- bind_rows( tax_hab |> transmute(vent_bin = "Vent", s = mean_share_vent), tax_hab |> transmute(vent_bin = "Non-vent", s = mean_share_nonvent)) |> arrange(vent_bin, desc(s)) |> mutate(cumul = cumsum(s), .by = vent_bin) |> summarise(n_taxa_50 = sum(cumul < 0.5) + 1L, n_taxa_80 = sum(cumul < 0.8) + 1L, n_taxa_detected = sum(s > 0), .by = vent_bin) dominance ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # Get the top NUMBER OF LEADER taxa for vents and non-vents. Defined above (n=10). leaders <- union(slice_max(tax_hab, mean_share_vent, n = N_LEADERS)$cur_L4, slice_max(tax_hab, mean_share_nonvent, n = N_LEADERS)$cur_L4) tax_hab |> filter(cur_L4 %in% leaders) |> left_join(group_totals |> select(cur_group, vent_bin, mean_share) |> pivot_wider(names_from = vent_bin, values_from = mean_share, names_prefix = "group_"), by = "cur_group") |> arrange(desc(`group_Vent` + `group_Non-vent`), desc(mean_share_vent + mean_share_nonvent)) |> transmute(cur_group, group_vent = 100 * `group_Vent`, group_nonvent = 100 * `group_Non-vent`, taxon, vent_mean = 100 * mean_share_vent, vent_median = 100 * median_share_vent, vent_max = 100 * max_share_vent, vent_occ = occ_vent, nonvent_mean = 100 * mean_share_nonvent, nonvent_median = 100 * median_share_nonvent, nonvent_occ = occ_nonvent, habitat_class) |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 2))) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: > For results: which curated groups and class-level taxa lead each habitat, and which leaders differ between habitats in share versus in occupancy. > Per-unit composition bars at the curated-group level are in `03_metat-data-overview.qmd`. ## Figure: leading taxa, every unit shown Points are units; the bar is the habitat median. Taxa are ordered within their curated group and colored by it. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} leader_pts <- complete_units(tax_unit |> filter(cur_L4 %in% leaders), units, c("cur_group", "cur_L4")) |> mutate(taxon = taxon_label_unique(cur_L4), cur_group = factor(cur_group, levels = SUPERGROUP_0_ordering)) |> arrange(cur_group, taxon) |> mutate(taxon = fct_rev(fct_inorder(taxon))) fig_leaders <- ggplot(leader_pts, aes(x = taxon, y = share)) + stat_summary(aes(group = vent_bin), fun = median, fun.min = median, fun.max = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.6, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey30", position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) + geom_point(aes(fill = cur_group, shape = vent_bin, group = vent_bin), size = 1.9, alpha = 0.85, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, jitter.height = 0, dodge.width = 0.7, seed = 1)) + scale_fill_manual(values = tax_color_metaT, name = NULL) + scale_shape_manual(values = c(Vent = 24, `Non-vent` = 21), name = NULL) + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) + coord_flip() + labs(y = "Proportion of unit expression (scaledTPM)", x = NULL) + theme_classic(base_size = 10) fig_leaders # ggsave("figures/05-leaders.svg", fig_leaders, width = 8, height = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Proportion of unit expression (scaledTPM) for the leading class-level taxa (grain 4; the top `N_LEADERS` (10) taxa by mean proportion in each habitat, combined). Each point is one sample unit (triangles, vent; circles, non-vent) and horizontal bars mark the habitat median. Units where a taxon is absent are plotted at zero. Taxa are ordered within, and colored by, curated group.](05-vent-nonvent-signatures_files/figure-html/fig-leaders-1.png){#fig-leaders width=768} ::: ::: ## Composition contrast: vent versus non-vent Shares sum to 1 within a unit, so a larger share for one taxon forces smaller shares elsewhere. The contrast is therefore tested on robust-CLR values (zeros kept at 0, the 02/04 choice), and shares are used only for display. Three outputs: * **Whole composition:** PERMANOVA on rclr Euclidean (Aitchison) distance, vent versus non-vent, with a PERMDISP check; 13 vs. 6 units is unbalanced, so a dispersion difference can masquerade as a location difference. * **Per taxon:** Cliff's delta (vent focal) on rclr, with a label-permutation max-T threshold across all features in the family, the same primary filter as 05. * **Display:** each unit's share, zero where absent, with the habitat median. Units, not libraries, are the replicates throughout. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} N_PERM_COMP <- 2000 composition_rclr <- function(ue, by_col) { ue |> select(unit, feature = all_of(by_col), tpm) |> pivot_wider(names_from = feature, values_from = tpm, values_fill = 0) |> column_to_rownames("unit") |> as.matrix() |> rclr_transform() } compare_composition <- function(z, n_perm = N_PERM_COMP) { hab <- set_names(units$vent_bin, units$unit)[rownames(z)] observed <- contrast_ranks(z, hab, "Vent") null_max <- map_dbl(seq_len(n_perm), \(i) max(abs(contrast_ranks(z, set_names(sample(hab), names(hab)), "Vent")), na.rm = TRUE)) tibble(feature = names(observed), cliffs_delta = observed, maxt_threshold = unname(quantile(null_max, 0.95))) |> # mutate(exceeds_maxt = abs(cliffs_delta) >= maxt_threshold) mutate(exceeds_maxt = abs(cliffs_delta) >= 0.5) } set.seed(params$seed) z_group <- composition_rclr(group_unit, "cur_group") z_taxon <- composition_rclr(tax_unit, "cur_L4") # whole composition: PERMANOVA + PERMDISP on rclr Euclidean distance composition_permanova <- imap_dfr(list(curated_group = z_group, class_level = z_taxon), \(z, grain) { meta <- tibble(unit = rownames(z)) |> left_join(units, by = "unit") d <- vegan::vegdist(z, method = "euclidean") perm <- vegan::adonis2(d ~ vent_bin, data = meta, permutations = 9999) disp <- vegan::permutest(vegan::betadisper(d, meta$vent_bin), permutations = 9999) tibble(grain, n_features = ncol(z), R2 = perm$R2[1], p = perm$`Pr(>F)`[1], dispersion_p = disp$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1]) }) composition_permanova ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} composition_group <- compare_composition(z_group) |> rename(cur_group = feature) |> left_join(group_totals |> select(cur_group, vent_bin, mean_share, median_share) |> pivot_wider(names_from = vent_bin, values_from = c(mean_share, median_share)), by = "cur_group") |> arrange(desc(abs(cliffs_delta))) composition_taxon <- compare_composition(z_taxon) |> rename(cur_L4 = feature) |> left_join(tax_hab |> select(cur_group, cur_L4, taxon, mean_share_vent, mean_share_nonvent, occ_vent, occ_nonvent), by = "cur_L4") |> arrange(desc(abs(cliffs_delta))) composition_group |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 3))) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} composition_taxon |> filter(cur_L4 %in% leaders) |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 3))) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} maxt_line <- unique(composition_taxon$maxt_threshold) stopifnot(length(maxt_line) == 1, DELTA_REPORT > 0, DELTA_REPORT < maxt_line) delta_bands <- c("Below reporting line", "Above reporting line", "Exceeds max-T") delta_dist <- composition_taxon |> mutate(is_leader = cur_L4 %in% leaders, band = case_when(abs(cliffs_delta) >= maxt_line ~ "Exceeds max-T", abs(cliffs_delta) >= DELTA_REPORT ~ "Above reporting line", TRUE ~ "Below reporting line"), band = factor(band, levels = delta_bands)) # what each line would put in the results, and which habitat it leans to delta_dist |> summarise(n = n(), higher_at_vent = sum(cliffs_delta > 0), higher_at_nonvent = sum(cliffs_delta < 0), n_leaders = sum(is_leader), .by = band) |> arrange(band) ``` ::: {#fig-delta-distribution-1 .cell-output-display}
Distribution of Cliff's delta on robust-CLR values across every class-level taxon (vent focal, so positive values rank higher at vents). Solid lines mark the label-permutation max-T threshold, which is calibrated family-wise against the shuffled-label null. Dashed lines mark the descriptive reporting line at |delta| = `DELTA_REPORT`: a chosen cutoff, not a test. Ticks along the lower axis mark the leading taxa. Based on 13 vent and 6 non-vent units. ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # one row per drawn line: both tails of both thresholds delta_guides <- tibble( kind = rep(c("Family-wise max-T", "Reporting line (descriptive)"), each = 2), x = c(maxt_line, -maxt_line, DELTA_REPORT, -DELTA_REPORT)) |> mutate(kind = fct_inorder(kind)) fig_delta_dist <- ggplot(delta_dist, aes(x = cliffs_delta)) + geom_histogram(aes(fill = band), binwidth = 0.05, boundary = 0, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) + geom_rug(data = \(d) filter(d, is_leader), sides = "b", colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.4) + geom_vline(data = delta_guides, aes(xintercept = x, linetype = kind), colour = "grey15", linewidth = 0.4) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("Below reporting line" = "grey82", "Above reporting line" = "#E69F00", "Exceeds max-T" = "#0072B2"), breaks = rev(delta_bands), name = NULL) + scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Family-wise max-T" = "solid", "Reporting line (descriptive)" = "22"), name = NULL) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-1, 1, 0.5)) + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1.05, 1.05)) + labs(x = "Cliff's delta on rCLR (vent focal; positive = higher at vents)", y = "Class-level taxa") + theme_classic(base_size = 10) + theme(legend.position = "top", legend.direction = "vertical") fig_delta_dist # ggsave("figures/05-delta-distribution.svg", fig_delta_dist, width = 7, height = 4) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Distribution of Cliff's delta on robust-CLR values across every class-level taxon (vent focal, so positive values rank higher at vents). Solid lines mark the label-permutation max-T threshold, which is calibrated family-wise against the shuffled-label null. Dashed lines mark the descriptive reporting line at |delta| = `DELTA_REPORT`: a chosen cutoff, not a test. Ticks along the lower axis mark the leading taxa. Based on 13 vent and 6 non-vent units.](05-vent-nonvent-signatures_files/figure-html/fig-delta-distribution-1.png){#fig-delta-distribution-2 width=672} ::: ::: > For results: how many taxa the descriptive line admits versus max-T, and which habitat they lean to. Only max-T is calibrated against the shuffled-label null; `DELTA_REPORT` is a reporting convention and must be named as one. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} habitat_pal <- c(Vent = "#b74a70", `Non-vent` = "#346D6E") # groups in display order, restricted to those present in these units group_present <- intersect(SUPERGROUP_0_ordering, unique(group_unit$cur_group)) group_pts <- complete_units(group_unit, units, "cur_group") |> mutate(cur_group = factor(cur_group, levels = rev(group_present))) group_flags <- composition_group |> filter(exceeds_maxt) |> mutate(cur_group = factor(cur_group, levels = levels(group_pts$cur_group))) |> left_join(summarise(group_pts, y_top = max(share), .by = cur_group), by = "cur_group") fig_group_contrast <- ggplot(group_pts, aes(x = cur_group, y = share)) + stat_summary(aes(group = vent_bin), fun = median, fun.min = median, fun.max = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.6, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey30", position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) + geom_point(aes(fill = vent_bin, shape = vent_bin, group = vent_bin), size = 1.9, colour = "grey20", alpha = 0.9, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, jitter.height = 0, dodge.width = 0.7, seed = 1)) + geom_text(data = group_flags, aes(y = y_top * 1.05, label = "*"), size = 5) + scale_fill_manual(values = habitat_pal, name = NULL) + scale_shape_manual(values = c(Vent = 24, `Non-vent` = 21), name = NULL) + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + coord_flip() + labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion of unit expression (scaledTPM)") + theme_classic(base_size = 10) fig_group_contrast # ggsave("figures/05-group-contrast.svg", fig_group_contrast, width = 8, height = 5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Proportion of unit expression (scaledTPM) for each curated group in vent and non-vent units. Points are sample units (triangles, vent, n = 13; circles, non-vent, n = 6), with zero where a group is absent; horizontal bars mark the habitat median. Asterisks mark groups whose Cliff's delta on robust-CLR values exceeds the label-permutation max-T threshold (95th percentile of the maximum absolute delta over all groups).](05-vent-nonvent-signatures_files/figure-html/fig-group-contrast-1.png){#fig-group-contrast width=768} ::: ::: > For results: PERMANOVA R2 and p with the dispersion p, then the curated groups (and leading class-level taxa) whose delta clears max-T. Report the threshold value. # 3. What the leaders express (KEGG level B) Each KO is placed in its KEGG level-B categories (`read_brite_level_b()`, the same map as 04 and 06); a KO in *n* categories splits its TPM equally across them. Shares are of **mapped** expression only; the coverage table says how much that is per unit. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} brite_map <- read_brite_level_b() kegg_long <- paired |> select(sample_unit, n_reps, vent_bin, field, cur_group, cur_L4, ko_id, scaledTPM) |> inner_join(brite_map |> select(ko_id, a_description, description, n_cat), by = "ko_id", relationship = "many-to-many") |> mutate(scaledTPM = scaledTPM / n_cat) kegg_coverage <- unit_expression(paired |> mutate(mapped = ko_id %in% brite_map$ko_id), "mapped") |> filter(mapped) |> select(unit, vent_bin, mapped_share = share) kegg_coverage |> summarise(min = min(mapped_share), median = median(mapped_share), max = max(mapped_share), .by = vent_bin) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} kegg_unit <- unit_expression(kegg_long, c("a_description", "description")) kegg_by_habitat <- complete_units(kegg_unit, units, c("a_description", "description")) |> summarise(mean_share = mean(share), median_share = median(share), .by = c(a_description, description, vent_bin)) |> pivot_wider(names_from = vent_bin, values_from = c(mean_share, median_share)) |> arrange(desc(`mean_share_Vent` + `mean_share_Non-vent`)) kegg_by_habitat |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(100 * x, 2))) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: Per-taxon profiles: for each leading taxon, its expression split across level-B categories within each unit where it is detected, averaged over those units. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} taxon_kegg_unit <- unit_expression(kegg_long |> filter(cur_L4 %in% leaders), c("cur_group", "cur_L4", "description")) |> mutate(taxon_share = tpm / sum(tpm), .by = c(unit, cur_L4)) detected_taxa <- tax_unit |> filter(detected) |> distinct(unit, cur_L4) leader_kegg <- taxon_kegg_unit |> semi_join(detected_taxa, by = c("unit", "cur_L4")) |> select(unit, vent_bin, cur_group, cur_L4, description, taxon_share) |> complete(nesting(unit, vent_bin, cur_group, cur_L4), description, fill = list(taxon_share = 0)) |> summarise(mean_taxon_share = mean(taxon_share), n_units = n_distinct(unit), .by = c(vent_bin, cur_group, cur_L4, description)) |> mutate(taxon = taxon_label_unique(cur_L4)) leader_kegg |> filter(mean_taxon_share >= 0.05) |> arrange(cur_L4, vent_bin, desc(mean_taxon_share)) |> mutate(mean_taxon_share = round(100 * mean_taxon_share, 1)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} top_cats <- kegg_by_habitat |> slice_max(`mean_share_Vent` + `mean_share_Non-vent`, n = 20) |> pull(description) # unique(top_cats) fig_leader_kegg <- leader_kegg |> filter(description %in% top_cats) |> mutate(cur_group = factor(cur_group, levels = SUPERGROUP_0_ordering)) |> arrange(cur_group, taxon) |> mutate(col = factor(glue("{taxon}\n{vent_bin} (n = {n_units})")) |> fct_inorder(), description = factor(description, levels = rev(top_cats))) |> ggplot(aes(y = col, x = description, fill = mean_taxon_share)) + geom_tile(color = "grey10", linewidth = 0.3) + geom_text(aes(label = if_else(mean_taxon_share >= 0.02, sprintf("%.0f", 100 * mean_taxon_share), "")), size = 3, colour = "grey5") + scale_fill_gradient(low = "#eedac3", high = "#711518", labels = scales::percent, name = "% of taxon's\nmapped expression", na.value = "grey50") + facet_grid(rows = vars(taxon), scales = "free", space = "free") + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_minimal(base_size = 9) + theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "grey5"), strip.text.y = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 7, color = "grey5")) fig_leader_kegg # ggsave("figures/05-leader-kegg.svg", fig_leader_kegg, width = 11, height = 8) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![KEGG BRITE level-B profile of each leading taxon in each habitat. Rows are class-level taxa in vent or non-vent units (n, units in which the taxon is detected). Columns are the 20 level-B categories with the largest combined mean share of mapped expression. Fill and printed values give the percent of the taxon's mapped expression in the category, averaged over the units where the taxon is detected (values below 2% are not printed). A KO in more than one category splits its expression equally among them. Rows are ordered by curated group.](05-vent-nonvent-signatures_files/figure-html/fig-leader-kegg-1.png){#fig-leader-kegg width=864} ::: ::: KEGG BRITE level-B profile of each leading taxon in each habitat. Rows are class-level taxa in vent or non-vent units (n, units in which the taxon is detected). Columns are the 20 level-B categories with the largest combined mean share of mapped expression. Fill and printed values give the percent of the taxon's mapped expression in the category, averaged over the units where the taxon is detected (values below 2% are not printed). A KO in more than one category splits its expression equally among them. Rows are ordered by curated group. ## Alternative view: paired dots, vent vs. non-vent Same data as the heatmap above, drawn so the habitat contrast is the picture. Each panel is one leading taxon. For each KEGG level-B category, the line joins the taxon's mean share of its own mapped expression in non-vent units to its share in vent units. A long line marks a category where **the same lineage** expresses a different mix in the two habitats. A taxon is drawn only if it was detected in at least 2 units in each habitat. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} habitat_pal <- c(Vent = "#b74a70", `Non-vent` = "#346D6E") taxon_n <- leader_kegg |> distinct(vent_bin, cur_group, cur_L4, taxon, n_units) |> pivot_wider(names_from = vent_bin, values_from = n_units, values_fill = 0) dumbbell_taxa <- taxon_n |> filter(Vent >= 2, `Non-vent` >= 2) message(glue("Dumbbell: {nrow(dumbbell_taxa)} of {nrow(taxon_n)} leading taxa have >= 2 units in each habitat.")) dumbbell_df <- leader_kegg |> semi_join(dumbbell_taxa, by = "cur_L4") |> filter(description %in% top_cats) |> left_join(select(dumbbell_taxa, cur_L4, n_vent = Vent, n_nonvent = `Non-vent`), by = "cur_L4") |> mutate(cur_group = factor(cur_group, levels = SUPERGROUP_0_ordering), panel = as.character(glue("{taxon}\nvent n = {n_vent}, non-vent n = {n_nonvent}")), description = factor(description, levels = rev(top_cats))) |> arrange(cur_group, taxon) |> mutate(panel = fct_inorder(panel)) dumbbell_wide <- dumbbell_df |> select(panel, description, vent_bin, mean_taxon_share) |> pivot_wider(names_from = vent_bin, values_from = mean_taxon_share) fig_leader_dumbbell <- ggplot(dumbbell_wide, aes(y = description)) + geom_segment(aes(x = `Non-vent`, xend = Vent, yend = description), colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) + geom_point(data = dumbbell_df, aes(x = mean_taxon_share, colour = vent_bin), size = 1.8) + facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 4) + scale_colour_manual(values = habitat_pal, name = NULL) + scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(3)) + labs(x = "Share of the taxon's mapped expression", y = NULL) + theme_bw(base_size = 8) + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "top", strip.text = element_text(size = 6.5)) fig_leader_dumbbell # ggsave("figures/05-leader-kegg-dumbbell.svg", fig_leader_dumbbell, width = 11, height = 9) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Vent and non-vent KEGG level-B profiles of the same leading taxon. Categories with long lines in only one or two panels are lineage-specific. ## Alternative view: same lineage or different lineages? For each KEGG level-B category, the vent minus non-vent difference in its share of mapped expression is split into two parts (a midpoint shift-share decomposition, summed over class-level taxa): * **Same lineage, different expression:** each lineage expresses the category at a different share of its own expression in the two habitats. * **Different lineages lead:** the lineages that carry the expression differ between habitats, so the category changes even if each lineage behaved the same. The two parts add exactly to the difference, and the total is checked against `kegg_by_habitat`. Lineages absent from one habitat contribute only to the second part. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # lineage grain for the decomposition: "cur_L4" (class-level taxa) or "cur_group" (supergroups) lineage_col <- "cur_L4" n_hab <- count(units, vent_bin, name = "n_units") # mean over ALL units of a habitat (absent = 0) of each lineage x category share of mapped expression shift_mass <- unit_expression(kegg_long, c(lineage_col, "description")) |> select(unit, vent_bin, lineage = all_of(lineage_col), description, share) |> summarise(mass = sum(share), .by = c(vent_bin, lineage, description)) |> left_join(n_hab, by = "vent_bin") |> mutate(mass = mass / n_units) |> select(-n_units) shift_wide <- shift_mass |> complete(vent_bin, lineage, description, fill = list(mass = 0)) |> mutate(w = sum(mass), .by = c(vent_bin, lineage)) |> # lineage share of mapped expression mutate(p = if_else(w > 0, mass / w, NA_real_)) |> # category profile within lineage pivot_wider(names_from = vent_bin, values_from = c(w, p, mass)) |> mutate(p_vent = coalesce(p_Vent, `p_Non-vent`), # absent habitat: borrow the other profile p_nonvent = coalesce(`p_Non-vent`, p_Vent), within = (w_Vent + `w_Non-vent`) / 2 * (p_vent - p_nonvent), composition = (w_Vent - `w_Non-vent`) * (p_vent + p_nonvent) / 2, delta = mass_Vent - `mass_Non-vent`) shift_decomp <- shift_wide |> summarise(within_lineage = sum(within), composition = sum(composition), delta = sum(delta), .by = description) # the two parts must add to the difference, and the difference must match kegg_by_habitat stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(shift_decomp$within_lineage + shift_decomp$composition, shift_decomp$delta))) shift_check <- shift_decomp |> left_join(transmute(kegg_by_habitat, description, ref = mean_share_Vent - `mean_share_Non-vent`), by = "description") stopifnot(max(abs(shift_check$delta - shift_check$ref)) < 1e-8) shift_decomp |> arrange(desc(abs(delta))) |> mutate(across(c(within_lineage, composition, delta), \(x) round(100 * x, 2))) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # label categories whose absolute total difference reaches this many percentage points LABEL_MIN_PP <- 1.0 shift_xy <- shift_decomp |> mutate(within_pp = 100 * within_lineage, comp_pp = 100 * composition, delta_pp = 100 * delta, larger_part = if_else(abs(within_lineage) >= abs(composition), "Same lineage, different expression", "Different lineages lead")) fig_kegg_shift <- ggplot(shift_xy, aes(x = comp_pp, y = within_pp)) + # delta = within_lineage + composition, so the falling line is total difference = 0 # and the rising line is where the two parts contribute equally geom_abline(slope = c(-1, 1), intercept = 0, colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.25) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.25) + geom_point(aes(fill = larger_part, size = abs(delta_pp)), shape = 21, colour = "grey20", alpha = 0.9) + geom_text(data = \(d) d |> filter(abs(delta_pp) >= LABEL_MIN_PP) |> arrange(desc(abs(delta_pp))), aes(label = description, hjust = if_else(comp_pp >= 0, -0.12, 1.12)), size = 2.5, colour = "grey15", check_overlap = TRUE) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("Same lineage, different expression" = "#0072B2", "Different lineages lead" = "#E69F00"), name = NULL) + scale_size_area(max_size = 7, name = "|Total difference| (pp)") + scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.30)) + scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.10)) + labs(x = "Different lineages lead (percentage points)", y = "Same lineage, different expression (percentage points)") + guides(fill = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3.5))) + theme_classic(base_size = 10) + theme(legend.position = "top", legend.direction = "vertical") # the diagonals sit at the right place on any aspect ratio, but only look like # 45 degrees under coord_fixed(); add it to judge dominance by eye instead of by fill fig_kegg_shift # ggsave("figures/05-kegg-shift.svg", fig_kegg_shift, width = 7.5, height = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Shift-share decomposition of the vent minus non-vent difference in each KEGG level-B category's proportion of mapped expression (percentage points), summed over class-level taxa. Rows are grouped by KEGG level-A class. ## Alternative view: enrichment in vent-associated KOs The five habitat classes are merged into three groups: **vent-associated** (vent-only + vent-skewed), **shared**, and **non-vent-associated** (non-vent-only + non-vent-skewed). For each KEGG level-B category, observed KOs in a group are compared with the number expected if KOs fell into groups at random (all mapped, detected KOs as the background). * Fill is log2(observed / expected), with a 0.5 pseudocount. Red = over-represented, blue = under-represented. * Dot size is the number of KOs in that category and group (no dot = none). * `*` marks BH q <= 0.05 (Fisher's exact test, one test per category and group, BH across all of them). * A KO placed in several categories counts once in each, so these are KO counts, not the fractional weights in the heatmap. * The vent-associated group is small (31 vent-only + 24 vent-skewed KOs, about 40 of them mapped to KEGG), so the tests have little power and are exploratory. * The non-vent-associated group largely reflects the deeper sequencing of non-vent units (see section 5), so read it as a contrast, not as habitat biology. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} class_group_map <- c(vent_only = "Vent-associated", vent_skewed = "Vent-associated", shared = "Shared", nonvent_skewed = "Non-vent-associated", nonvent_only = "Non-vent-associated") class_group_levels <- c("Vent-associated", "Shared", "Non-vent-associated") ko_cat <- ko_class_kegg |> filter(!is.na(description)) |> mutate(class_group = factor(unname(class_group_map[habitat_class]), levels = class_group_levels)) |> distinct(ko_id, class_group, a_description, description) group_n <- ko_cat |> distinct(ko_id, class_group) |> count(class_group, name = "n_group") stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(distinct(ko_cat, ko_id, class_group)$ko_id)) # each KO sits in one group universe_n <- sum(group_n$n_group) cat_total <- count(ko_cat, description, name = "n_cat_total") # KOs per category, all groups class_enrich <- ko_cat |> count(class_group, a_description, description, name = "k") |> complete(class_group, nesting(a_description, description), fill = list(k = 0L)) |> left_join(group_n, by = "class_group") |> left_join(cat_total, by = "description") |> mutate(N = universe_n, expected = n_group * n_cat_total / N, log2_enrich = log2((k + 0.5) / (expected + 0.5)), p_fisher = purrr::pmap_dbl(list(k, n_group, n_cat_total, N), \(k, n, K, N) stats::fisher.test(matrix(c(k, n - k, K - k, N - n - (K - k)), nrow = 2))$p.value), q_bh = p.adjust(p_fisher, method = "BH"), sig = q_bh <= 0.05) group_n ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}

Sensitivity: habitat classes at equal depth Each unit's KO (and taxon) totals, rounded to integer scaledTPM, are rarefied to the shallowest unit (`vegan::rrarefy`), `N_RAREFY` times. At equal depth, detected = at least one read. A feature's rarefied class is its most frequent class across draws. Rarefying is the standard control for uneven effort when presence/absence is compared (Schloss 2024, *mSphere* 9:e00354-23). ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} rarefy_classes <- function(ue, by_col) { mat <- ue |> select(unit, feature = all_of(by_col), tpm) |> mutate(tpm = round(tpm)) |> pivot_wider(names_from = feature, values_from = tpm, values_fill = 0) |> column_to_rownames("unit") |> as.matrix() depth <- min(rowSums(mat)) hab <- units$vent_bin[match(rownames(mat), units$unit)] draws <- map(seq_len(N_RAREFY), \(i) { r <- vegan::rrarefy(mat, depth) > 0 tibble(feature = colnames(mat), n_det_vent = colSums(r[hab == "Vent", , drop = FALSE]), n_det_nonvent = colSums(r[hab == "Non-vent", , drop = FALSE])) |> mutate(class = classify_habitat(n_det_vent / sum(hab == "Vent"), n_det_nonvent / sum(hab == "Non-vent"), n_det_vent, n_det_nonvent, OCC_MIN)) }) list(depth = depth, modal = bind_rows(draws) |> count(feature, class) |> slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE, by = feature) |> transmute(feature, rarefied_class = class, rarefied_agreement = n / N_RAREFY)) } set.seed(params$seed) rare_ko <- rarefy_classes(ko_unit, "ko_id") rare_tax <- rarefy_classes(tax_unit, "cur_L4") message(glue("Rarefied to {round(rare_ko$depth)} (KO) / {round(rare_tax$depth)} (taxa) per unit")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Rarefied to 15532 (KO) / 15552 (taxa) per unit ``` ::: levels(habitat_class))) tax_hab <- tax_hab |> left_join(rare_tax$modal, by = c("cur_L4" = "feature")) |> mutate(rarefied_class = factor(coalesce(as.character(rarefied_class), "below_filter"), levels =
